path_resolution.read_basis: Read file_path resolves against explicit cwd when cwd is provided; otherwise it is relative to the keeper sandbox/sandbox_roots. It does not inherit Execute cwd implicitly.

path_resolution.execute_path_basis: Execute path arguments resolve against cwd. When cwd is set, pass paths relative to it; do not repeat the cwd prefix in the path.
path_resolution.masc_state_basis: .masc runtime state is not a sandbox filesystem target. Use keeper task/context tools for .masc state instead of Read/Grep/Execute paths under .masc.

route_evidence.description: Interact with an explicit Firefox/Zen tab; no arbitrary JavaScript. Read again after success or failure before retrying: page handlers can change external state. click/fill require one visible inspected element; fill targets text inputs/textarea and sends input/change without Enter or submit. scroll_at scrolls the pane under the point. drag uses trusted automation pointers. follow_link bypasses click handlers for observed same-tab HTTP(S) HTML/SVG anchors (_self/_top/_parent); rejects downloads, new-window targets, noreferrer and explicit referrerpolicy. destinationUrl is intent, not loaded-page evidence. activate_tab is live-only (extension >=0.6.0): verifies active=true without window focus or navigation.
